# Fixpenses

> Fixpenses is a personal finance and expense tracking app for UAE residents. It tracks credit cards, bank accounts, bills, installments (taksit), budgets and savings goals in AED, without asking for online banking logins.

## Product

- [Features](https://fixpenses.com/features): overview of everything Fixpenses does
- [Expense tracking](https://fixpenses.com/features/expense-tracking)
- [Credit card management](https://fixpenses.com/features/credit-card-management)
- [Bank account management](https://fixpenses.com/features/bank-account-management)
- [Budgets and spending limits](https://fixpenses.com/features/budget-spending-limits)
- [Savings goals](https://fixpenses.com/features/financial-savings-goals)
- [Reports and analytics](https://fixpenses.com/features/expense-reports-analytics)
- [Pricing](https://fixpenses.com/pricing): free Starter plan, Pro AED 9.99/month, Premium AED 29/month
